blocks.purpose: Skip attack and transfer immediately.
blocks.entry: Exactly one process; private pointers and counters; pristine image.
blocks.processEffect: One process throughout; SPL is written as a bomb, never executed locally.
blocks.cost: Measured after assembly, including data and linking instructions.
blocks.searchLimits: Current shared search: STEP 1..2048, HOP 256..7000, WAIT 1..768, STUN 1..4096. This deliberately bounded first grammar does not cover every landing site in 94x.
blocks.limitations: Solo behavior does not guarantee safety after enemy writes. No arbitrary block ordering or shared-state concurrency.

standaloneRecipes.purpose: Original contiguous boot, bounded guarded bomber and independent fallback process.
standaloneRecipes.entry: One process at boot or launch; private pristine payload.
standaloneRecipes.processes: Two processes during bombing; stone retires intentionally, watchdog exclusively owns clear counters; one final survivor in tested scenarios.
standaloneRecipes.writes: Bombs and clear exclude the complete active payload. Probe, timers, flag and clear pointers are private mutable B-fields.
standaloneRecipes.composition: A separate process-aware grammar; do not splice into single-process clear recipes.
standaloneRecipes.limitations: Tests cover exact copy, attack coverage and selected injected faults, not arbitrary enemy damage. Initial search did not establish general superiority.
